title: Compared to What? A Human-Anchored Security Benchmark for LLM-Generated Infrastructure-as-Code
reasons: 摘要级材料不足以进入优先审核，等待补充官方材料
missingSignals: 描述评分指标或评测协议

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce GenIaC-SecBench, a benchmark of 100 deployment scenarios stratified by architectural complexity, evaluated across 12 model configurations from four vendors, producing 1,196 IaC artifacts scanned by three independent policy engines (Checkov, Trivy, KICS).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: When matched on declared-resource count, all model configurations fall within 3.21x--3.87x the human vulnerability density, with the gap widening for simpler tasks (4.9x at one resource, 1.4x at twenty or more).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Prior evaluations report raw vulnerability counts for model-generated IaC, but without a human baseline they cannot determine whether models are actually worse than engineers.
